chapter: Melvin Moore, Hammond and the New York trip
title: Auditioning for Hammond at the Crystal Palace
summary: Fields plays for Hammond at Walter Tate's Crystal Palace and arranges for Hammond and Alexander to hear the band in Wichita.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

blocks.x: When I got the news, my wife handed me the note, and I woke up, I said what is this and she explained what it was and I don't know if I slept anymore that morning; John Hammond wanted to talk to me.

Of course I knew who he was and everything and so about ten o'clock I called John Hammond. So he says, I thought you worked last night; I told him I did. You're up already? I said yes, I'm up, you said you wanted to talk to me. He said yes, but I thought you'd be getting your rest, I thought you'd call about twelve or one o'clock, and so he explained himself and he said he wanted to catch the group,

could you arrange for me? I said sure. So I called the boys and everything and they hadn't gotten up, I was glad I started early because they hadn't moved out. So I told them and they were all enthused and we went to the Crystal Palace.

One of the co-owners of the Crystal Palace was my ex-boss when I was working in the electric shop, Walter Tate; he was co-owner of the Crystal Palace and I wanted to know if I could get it and he said you know very well you can; he laughed.

So we were on time, whatever time he said, three or four o'clock, and Hammond came down. We set up and played several numbers and just from the first number you could just see he was all smiles; then he would say play me a different type and we would play that; and he was just all smiles. He said, I'll tell you what, the band is terrific, but I'm not a musician but I do know what's good and what I like. If Willard Alexander, who is head of
the band department of the William Morris Agency, if he thinks half as much of you as I do, he'll take us to New York on a tour and I'll get him to sign you up.

So I told him okay and he said when can he come and hear you and I said well, I'll check my itinerary. Well I knew right then several things, but I didn't want him to come to some little hick town where I was the night he asked about me, so I began to try to think of some town where we might have a decent crowd.

So I had a date about two weeks from then in Wichita, Kansas and so I called Hammond at his hotel and I told him that I'd be in Wichita, Kansas on such and such a date and he said well, I'll see how Willard's schedule is and I'll call you back. So after he called Alexander he called me back and said we'll be there, we'll be in Wichita, Kansas and what hall and I gave him the name of the hall and I gave him the address and he said we'll see you.
